title: Odile and the Asset
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: August Dunmore, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
